verdict.detail: Discogs lists 2 variants of it; the run-outs and label details tell the earliest.

notes.text:
First issue with twin logo over a red dragon on the labels (coloured Roger Dean label).
Inner sleeve is black paper over plastic polyethylene, white Virgin logo and data over black background.

On centre label side B, track B5 is divided in two parts numbered 5 (Muddy Mouse (c)) and 6 (Muddy Mouth), but is actually only one band on the vinyl. On the record sleeve, track B5 is listed as "Muddy Mouse (c) which in turn leads to Muddy Mouth" (with the two song titles "Muddy Mouse (c)" and "Muddy Mouth" in italics) indicating that this track is two songs that segue (the linking phrase "which in turn leads to" being a reference to a lyric from Muddy Mouth).
---
Recorded and mixed at the Manor, except A2, recorded at CBS London.
